title: Productionize commit and PR evidence generation
description:
Turn worker output, validation results, and git diff evidence into high-quality semantic commits and PR descriptions. Use deterministic guards where possible and Tactus/LLM generation where intelligence is useful.

Acceptance:
- Commit messages follow conventional/semantic style.
- PR bodies include task context, change summary, validation, risks, and evidence.
- Kanbus rejects missing or low-quality required PR sections before publication.
